exam_scheme.note: The Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test (INI-CET) is conducted by AIIMS New Delhi on a biannual basis (January and July sessions) for admission to postgraduate medical courses (MD, MS, M.Ch 6-year, DM 6-year, and MDS) across AIIMS New Delhi and all new AIIMS, JIPMER Puducherry, NIMHANS Bengaluru, PGIMER Chandigarh, and SCTIMST Thiruvananthapuram. The exam is a 3-hour Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 200 objective questions covering preclinical, paraclinical, and clinical subjects. Marking scheme: 1 mark for each correct response, negative marking of 1/3 (0.33) marks for each incorrect response.
